info.title: Start here
info.description: IKON Tool is a command-line utility that is used for signing in, project creation, pipeline running, and more.

options.name: --project-dir
options.description: Directory to download the app into (defaults to the current directory)

options.name: --app-id
options.description: App whose token the command runs with

options.description: Print the current version of the IKON tool

options.name: --all-keys
